name: What should I check first before insulating my garage?

mainEntity.name: What should I check first before insulating my garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your garage feels freezing in winter or overheated in summer, insulation usually helps the most when the garage shares a wall or ceiling with living space. Start by checking air leaks, wall cavities, the garage door, and any ceiling areas below bedrooms or hallways, because those are the most common weak points in Denver-area homes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check air leaks, shared walls, the ceiling over living space, and the garage door first. Those areas usually create the biggest comfort and energy losses.
